description: Marks one update read (notice_id, from whats_waiting's `updates`) or every update listed for the person (all: true), once you have passed it on. Read is the person's own: it leaves their CodeGene Inbox on every device and their list here, and a teammate still sees it until they read it. Answers how many were marked.

all.description: true to mark every update listed for the person read.

notice_id.description: One update (whats_waiting lists them under updates).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: mark_updates_read
title: Mark updates read
